description: This file defines the TeleSuiteUpdater class, which manages test suite updates, reporting, and error handling within a testing framework, utilizing TeleReporterReceiver and related types.

classes.name: TeleSuiteUpdater
classes.description: Manages updating and reporting of test suites, including configuration, progress, error handling, and event processing.

methods.name: _createReporter
methods.description: Creates a ReporterV2 object with event handlers for test configuration, start, end, and error events.

methods.name: processGlobalReport
methods.description: Processes a global report array, dispatching messages to a new TeleReporterReceiver.

methods.name: processListReport
methods.description: Processes a list report, saving current test results and resetting the receiver.

methods.name: processTestReportEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a test report event to both last run and main receivers.

methods.name: _handleOnError
methods.description: Handles test errors by recording and invoking error callbacks.

methods.name: asModel
methods.description: Returns the current state of the test suite updater as a model object.
